calls.bash: mu task claim h1 -w eval --for w1 && mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do h1 and close it'
mu task claim h2 -w eval --for w2 && mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do h2 and close it'
mu task wait h1 h2 -w eval --timeout 120
for t in h1 h2; do ev=$(mu task notes $t -w eval | grep -o "eval: .* run=[0-9a-f]*" | tail -1); echo "$t: $ev"; done > summary.md; cat summary.md

text: h1 and h2 were done by their workers; summary.md has their evidence.
